title: Database connection pool exhaustion
question: Investigate why checkout API requests are timing out. Identify the most likely cause and supporting evidence.

entries: ERROR checkout-api: timed out waiting for a database connection after 3000ms
INFO deployment: no deploys in past 24h

guidance: Check database connection pool utilization and slow queries.
Do not restart or resize without operator approval.

title: CPU saturation from unexpected batch job
question: Why did analytics API latency spike at 09:00? Investigate using available evidence.
root_cause: CPU saturation from a concurrent batch job

entries: INFO scheduler: ad-hoc batch aggregation started at 08:59
WARN analytics-api: CPU throttling detected at 09:01

guidance: Correlate CPU pressure with concurrent jobs.
Pause jobs only with human authorization.

title: Memory exhaustion in stream worker
question: Investigate repeated stream-worker restarts and increasing processing lag.
root_cause: memory exhaustion causing out-of-memory worker restarts

entries: ERROR kernel: Out of memory: Killed process stream-worker
WARN orchestrator: stream-worker restarted after OOMKilled

guidance: Review heap growth and memory limits.
Memory limit changes require human approval.

title: Upstream dependency returns 503

WARN retry: upstream billing-api request failed 5 consecutive times

title: Insufficient evidence
question: Investigate an intermittent latency alert. Can you confirm the root cause?
